about: One line per verdict a person gave on one vine in the Vines tool, in its range lab or its Vine tab: Good or Bad, with every setting it was grown from and whether it passed validation. Used to narrow a kind's ranges from evidence. Nothing is removed.

fields.time: When the verdict was given, UTC, ISO 8601.
fields.note: What the person wrote, if anything.
fields.attempt: Which deterministic re-roll of that seed grew it (0: its own roll).
fields.changed: true when a setting was changed by hand in the Vine tab: the settings are then not the seed's own roll.
fields.generator: The git commit the generator was at, with "+changes" when its code had uncommitted edits.
fields.settings: Every setting it was grown from, by name (VineParams).
fields.measures: voxels, pods, leaves, height_m, lean_deg, kink_deg, sag_m.
